Today's Homework
~45 minutes
Here's how I'd spend it. Check off each block as you go.
Delivery
How you say it matters as much as what you say.
Tonality
Signal confidence without saying it.
Go flat on facts. Go curious on questions. Go calm on objections. Uptalk turns statements into questions — and kills credibility instantly.
Speed
Slow down when it counts.
Reps speed up when nervous — especially on the math slide. Slow down exactly when you feel like rushing. Pace = control.
Enthusiasm
Real energy, not performed energy.
Match the prospect's register first, then elevate slightly. Forced enthusiasm on a cold prospect reads as tone-deaf. Genuine belief in the product is contagious.
Posture
Your body affects your voice.
Sit up, lean forward slightly. Slouching compresses your diaphragm and flattens your voice. Good posture physically opens up your tone and projection.
Feet up energy
Own the call before it starts.
Relaxed, confident, in control. Not casual — comfortable. You're not hoping the call goes well. You already know it will.
Prospects don't just buy the product — they buy the person selling it. Your delivery is part of the pitch.
